messages:
Alice M: Heads-up — we have a release cutover tonight at 02:00 UTC. Planning a tfstate splay for infra (split state to reduce lock contention). Need volunteer to run the staggered applies and own rollback decisions.
Brian K: I can take the first 2 waves. What timebox are we using per wave?
Alice M: thinking 10m wave with 5m verification, then next wave. total ~45-60m including smoke tests.
Carla Ops: Can we pin provider and module versions for the release? last-minute provider upgrade caused drift last month.
Dana S: Yes — pinning in the release branch is already in PR: `modules/*/versions.tf` set to `~> 3.2.1`. We should also snapshot state before the first apply: `terraform state pull > state-snapshot-1769876543.json`.
Infra Oncall: +1 on snapshot. Also add a quick verification script to check expected route tables and IAM trusts after each wave.
Alice M: I'll add verification steps to release notes and post the link. Also we'll enable DeployBot quiet mode so merges are blocked during the change window.
Alice M: Release notes: https://redwood-internal/release/1769 — includes steps, rollback criteria, and contact list.
Brian K: workflow for apply I plan to run (example):
```
# wave 1
export TF_WORKSPACE=prod
terraform plan -var-file=wave1.tfvars -out=wave1.plan
terraform apply -input=false wave1.plan
# verify
./scripts/check-networking.sh --expect 200
```
Carla Ops: Rollback criteria suggestion: any >=2 nodes failing healthcheck OR route propagation errors to >1 AZ OR unexplained IAM denies. If hit, stop further waves and run revert plan. :warning:
Dana S: Revert plan prepared: `terraform apply -state=state-snapshot-1769876543.json revert.plan` (keeps resources in previous known-good). I've posted the revert steps in the notes.
DeployBot: Deploy window locked by Alice M — merges to `release/*` branch blocked. Scheduled start: 1769877600 (02:00 UTC). :robot_face:
Infra Oncall: I'll monitor metrics and be on pager for the window. If any anomalous spike in LB 5xx or KMS errors, I'll call the rollback.
Brian K: Starting wave 1 in ~20m, ping me in thread when ready.
Alice M: Roger. Also tagging security: @Carla Ops — confirm KMS key rotation is disabled during the window?
Carla Ops: Confirmed disabled for the window.
DeployBot: Wave 1 apply job started by Brian K — logs: `apply-wave1-1769876543.log` (link).
DeployBot: Wave 1 apply succeeded. Verification checks passed.
Brian K: Wave 2 started.
DeployBot: Wave 2 apply failed on `aws_iam_role` update — error: `dependent resources exist`. Logs: `apply-wave2-1769876605.log`.
Dana S: Pausing further waves. I'm investigating the IAM error; likely stale role assumers in prod.
Alice M: Hold all remaining waves. Brian, can you run `terraform plan -destroy` on the problematic resource and post plan?
Brian K: On it.
Infra Oncall: Observability looks stable aside from a brief spike in IAM API error 403s coincident with the apply failure. No user-facing incidents.
Dana S: Root cause: a legacy service account (svc-legacy-recon) has an inline policy preventing role update. I can patch that policy to allow the update, then re-run wave 2.
Carla Ops: If we patch inline policy, record change in audit and include in release notes appendix.
Alice M: Decision: patch inline policy, re-run wave 2 after validation. If wave 2 fails again or causes >1% error rate sustained for >2m, we revert to snapshot. Agreed?
All: :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Wave 2 retry scheduled by Dana S.
DeployBot: Wave 2 apply succeeded. Final verification run passed. Release cutover complete.
Alice M: Great work team — will follow up with postmortem and update release notes with the inline policy fix. Thanks everyone.
